lines.en: Hey, Freddie texted me saying you guys had a fire.
I already told my granddad and Spencer they were fake.
then his chicken burst into flames,
and now I'm moving to Yakima.
So this fire is your fault.
Because of you, I had to stop right in the middle
of rubbing anti-tick lotion on Freddie.
They hide in your leg hair.
I was making dinner and it caught on fire.
Well, you're lucky no one got hurt.
Carly should go live with you.
Well, I'm glad you see it my way, Spence.
You can come visit any time you like.
This is some good chicken stir-fry.
I'm ready to ruin my life.
Look, I know you're upset, kiddo, but once you smell that Yakima air, you'll feel better.
Yes, the sweet smell of Yakima.
Everything you need to know about taking care of Carly.
I listed all of her allergies, the number for poison control.
These are Carly's favorite foods, drinks, soups, and chowders.
Aren't soups and chowders the same thing?
Uh, this is her homework schedule and the number for a good tutor, 'cause she's been having
Oh, and these are the vitamins she needs to take every day.
I only give her the ones shaped like dinosaurs.
Oh, and she's really into drinking coffee.
I always give her decaf without telling her.
So, who's gonna take the blame when I put live lobsters in the trunk of Miss Briggs' car?
Will you at least try to stay out of trouble?
Okay, well, I guess this is--
Freddie, let go of my legs.
Lost my cool for a sec there.
You can't lose what you never had.
Aren't you gonna say goodbye to Spencer?
We already did before you came up.
Will you guys come down to the lobby with me?
No, Freddy's not here, Mrs. Benson.
I don't know when I grew leg hair!
Okay, the car's right out front.
Oh, young man, would you mind getting the rest--
I haven't had an asthma attack since I was seven.
- Well, yeah, but you know, you never know.
- Why did you keep that all these years?
- Nah, I'm not gonna need this.
- Look, asthma's tricky. - I'm not gonna need this,
because I want Carly to stay here with you.
